entry.title: HSG-Backed Robotera Is Said to Mull HK IPO as Robot Tech Booms
entry.summary: Robotera, a Chinese robotics startup backed by HSG and CDH Investments, is planning an initial public offering in Hong Kong, people familiar with the matter said, as a growing number of companies in the industry look to go public.

entry.title: Anthropic Revenue Ahead of IPO Surges Over 14-Fold in Second Quarter
entry.summary: Anthropic PBC is telling prospective investors its second-quarter revenue jumped at least 14-fold versus the same period a year ago, according to documents seen by Bloomberg News.

entry.title: SpaceX Completes Its $60 Billion Cursor Acquisition
entry.summary: SpaceX has completed a $60 billion acquisition of artificial intelligence coding startup Cursor, a key part of Elon Musk’s bid to gain ground on rivals Anthropic PBC and OpenAI.
